meta.name: analytical-method-validation
meta.description: Plan, execute, and document validation, verification, and transfer of analytical procedures under the governing framework - ICH Q2(R2) and Q14, USP <1220>/<1225>/<1226>, ICH M10 bioanalytical, CLSI EP, or ISO/IEC 17025. Use for HPLC, LC-MS/MS, GC, CE, ICP-MS, dissolution, qNMR, qPCR, NIR, and ligand binding or cell-based assays whenever the question is whether a procedure is fit for its intended purpose. Triggers include "method validation", "analytical method validation", "AMV", "validation protocol", "acceptance criteria", "linearity", "reportable range", "accuracy and precision", "repeatability", "intermediate precision", "recovery", "LOD", "LOQ", "detection limit", "quantitation limit", "specificity", "robustness", "method transfer", "method comparison", "Deming", "Passing-Bablok", "Bland-Altman", "equivalence testing", "OOS investigation", "ICH Q2", "Q2(R2)", "Q14", "USP 1225", "ICH M10", "incurred sample reanalysis", "ISR", "CLSI EP", and any request to show that an assay works.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 验证分析方法是否符合法规要求
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在制药或生物分析实验室中验证分析方法的合规性。
copy.tagline_en: Validate analytical methods for regulatory compliance
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to validate analytical methods in pharma or bioanalysis labs.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会按所选法规框架规划分析方法验证/确认/转移研究，计算线性、准确度、精密度、检测限等统计量，并生成带待填接受标准的方案文档；它只报告数据，不替用户下“已验证”的结论。
howto.when: 当问题涉及分析方法是否适合其预期用途时触发，例如提到“方法验证”“线性”“LOD/LOQ”等关键词，或要求制定验证方案、比较方法、调查OOS时。

say.text: 帮我按ICH Q2(R2)规划一个HPLC含量测定方法的验证方案
say.note: 会生成方案草稿，并提示在接受标准处先做决定。

say.text: 检查这份LC-MS/MS批次数据是否满足ICH M10的色谱法要求
say.note: 会按ICH M10的容差规则标出失败的质控水平。

say.text: 用Deming回归和TOST比较两台仪器的配对结果是否等效
say.note: 会给出等效性结论及对应的统计量。

howto.what_en: Claude plans validation/transfer of analytical methods under a selected framework, computes linearity, accuracy, precision, detection limits, and drafts protocols with acceptance criteria left blank. It reports data; it never concludes validation.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the question is whether an analytical procedure is fit for its purpose, e.g. on keywords like method validation, linearity, LOD/LOQ, or when asked to plan a validation study, compare methods, or investigate OOS.

say_en.text: Help me plan an ICH Q2(R2) validation protocol for an HPLC assay.
say_en.note: Generates a protocol draft with acceptance criteria to be decided.

say_en.text: Check this LC-MS/MS run against ICH M10 chromatographic criteria.
Compare paired results from two instruments with Deming regression and TOST.
say_en.note: Shows equivalence at the stated margin.
